An '''ammo pouch''' was a small pouch used to hold ammunition. [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], disguised as the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boushh/Legends|Boushh]], wore an ammo pouch as part of her [[Armor/Legends|armor]] while infiltrating [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].
